sanskrit: antarhitaṃ me bṛhad antarikṣam antarhitāḥ parvatā agnayo me | maiṣāṃ rādhy abhicāra eṣa pratyag enān pratisareṇa hanmi ||
english: Concealed for me is the vast mid-air; concealed for me are the mountains and the fires. Let not this sorcery of theirs succeed — I strike them back with the pratisara amulet.

sanskrit: tapaḥśramāv antarau mat parītaṃ brahmayajñam antaraṃ mad dadhāmi | (…) ||
english: Tapas and toil I place as a double concealment around me; I set the brahma-sacrifice as a concealment within me. […]

sanskrit: agnīṣomāv antarau mad bhavātho divaṃ varma pṛthivīṃ ca kṛṇve | (…) ||
english: May Agni and Soma become a double concealment for me; I make heaven and earth my armour. […]

sanskrit: antarhitaṃ me sāma prastutam antarhitaḥ parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ | (…) ||
english: Concealed for me is the sāman that has been intoned; concealed for me is Parameṣṭhin Prajāpati. […]

sanskrit: antarhitā sarparājñī vīrāṇ me antarhitaḥ puruṣo medhyo me | (…) ||
english: Concealed for me is the queen of serpents together with my heroes; concealed for me is the sacrificial man. […]

sanskrit: antarhitā me ṣaḍ urvīḥ sadhrīcīr antarhitāḥ sādhyā āptyā me | (…) ||
english: Concealed for me are the six broad realms arrayed together; concealed for me are the Sādhyas and the Āptyas. […]

sanskrit: (antarhitā) ma ṛṣayaḥ pracetaso antarhitaḥ sūryo mātariśvā | (…) ||
english: Concealed for me are the wise seers; concealed are the Sun and Mātariśvan. […]

sanskrit: antarhitā me nadyaḥ syandamānā antarhitā oṣadhīḥ puṣpiṇīr me (…) ||
english: Concealed for me are the flowing rivers; concealed for me are the flowering plants. […]

sanskrit: antarhitāḥ paśavaḥ kakṣyā me antarhitaṃ vayo yat patatri | (…) ||
english: Concealed for me are the tethered cattle; concealed is every bird that flies. […]

sanskrit: antarhitā ma iṣavo brāhmaṇānām antarhitā vanaspatayaḥ samūlāḥ | (…) ||
english: Concealed for me are the arrows of the brāhmaṇas; concealed for me are the forest trees with their roots. […]

sanskrit: antarhitā devatalpāḥ puro me antarhitā jagatī chandasāṃ me | (…) ||
english: Concealed before me are the divine couches; concealed for me is the jagatī among the metres. […]

sanskrit: antarhitā me samudrā dvādaśā antarhitā uṣasi tārakā me | (…) ||
english: Concealed for me are the twelve oceans; concealed for me are the stars at dawn. […]

sanskrit: antarhitā agnayo dhiṣṇyā me antarhitā ṛtava ārtavā me | (…) ||
english: Concealed for me are the dhiṣṇya fires; concealed for me are the seasonal rites of the seasons. […]

sanskrit: antarhitā me pradiśaś catasro antar bhūtam uta bhavyaṃ dadhe 'ham | maiṣāṃ rādhy abhicāra eṣa pratyag enān pratisareṇa hanmi ||
english: Concealed for me are the four cardinal directions; I hold within myself both the past and the future. Let not this sorcery of theirs succeed — I strike them back with the pratisara amulet.

sanskrit: hanmi te 'haṃ kṛtaṃ havir yo me ghoram acīkṛtaḥ | apāñcau ta ubhau bāhū api nahyāmy āsyam ||
english: I smite the oblation you have made — you who have wrought this dreadful act against me. Both your arms I bind behind your back; I bind shut your mouth.

sanskrit: api nahyāmi te bāhū api nahyāmy āsyam | agner devasya manyunā tena te 'vadhiṣaṃ havir yo me ghoram acīkṛtaḥ ||
english: I bind your two arms; I bind shut your mouth. With the wrath of the god Agni I have slain the oblation of you who wrought this dreadful act against me.

sanskrit: uditaḥ śatayojanam indro vartayate ratham | sāyakaṃ kṣuravartmānam aher jātāni jambhayan ||
english: Having risen, Indra wheels his chariot a hundred yojanas; bearing his sharp-edged arrow, he crushes the serpent broods.

sanskrit: dṛḍhāsa āsann ahayo hatā udarasarpiṇaḥ | puccham udveṣṭayantaḥ śvā piṇḍam adann iva ||
english: Stiff they lay — the serpents slain, those that creep with their bellies — their tails curling up, as a dog gnaws a lump of meat.

sanskrit: pāpaka pāparūpaka kiṃ me sakhāyam ātudaḥ | na mām apaśya āgataṃ satīnaṃ viṣadūṣaṇam ||
english: Evil one, evil-formed one, why did you sting my companion? You did not see me coming — me, the true antidote to poison.

sanskrit: ahijambhāś carāmasi muṣkābarho gavām iva | pīlā upa svajaṃ hanma upa stambhe pṛdākvam ||
english: We move about as crushers of serpents, with scrota drooping like those of bulls. We strike the embrace of the pīlā plant against the spotted snake; we drive it against the post.

sanskrit: ye ke cedam upāsauṣur vātasyeva pṛthag yataḥ | aṅgo nu sarve brūta- -āheyam arasaṃ viṣam ||
english: All those who have sat here attending to this, dispersed like the wind from here and there — come now, all of you declare: the serpent's venom is without potency!

sanskrit: triddhisi te niṣadanaṃ tripuṣi pāpa te gṛhaḥ | acchinnaṃ tvā vāto hanty acchinnam abhi varṣati ||
english: Threefold is your resting place, O wicked one; three-tufted is your lair. The wind strikes you without cutting you off; it rains upon you without cutting you off.

sanskrit: nākulena bheṣajena tenāhīn jambhayāmasi | māṃścatur nāma vṛkṣakaḥ sa enān arasān akaḥ ||
english: With the mongoose remedy we crush the serpents. The small tree named māṃścatur — it has made them devoid of venom.

sanskrit: asitāhe 'rasaṃ viṣam ubhayoḥ sitasya ca | abhikrandasya yā ropīs tā ito 'pa nayāmasi ||
english: The venom of the dark serpent is without potency, as is that of the light one and of both together. The festering sores of the roaring one — those we drive away from here.

sanskrit: idaṃ paidvo ajāyata- -idam asya vivartanam | idaṃ kanikrado mṛgo viṣam eti parābhavam ||
english: This is what the Paidva herb was born for; this is its turning and unfolding. This roaring creature's venom goes to destruction.

sanskrit: viṣūcīnā vātā vāntu viṣvag varṣantu vṛṣṭayaḥ | viṣvag viṣaṃ pra meha tvaṃ śatadhāra ivāvaṭaḥ ||
english: Let the winds blow in all directions; let the rains rain on all sides. Flow forth your venom in all directions, like a cistern with a hundred streams.
